authorization_scope: User-authorized one-time Schlusser HepG2 TE confirmatory evaluation only; Gate 0 historical authorized_model_execution=false remains unchanged
model_output_units: measured MRL after each member train-only inverse target transform

paired_seeds.note: 101,202,...,10100; same proposals across methods and caps use nested prefixes

proposal_distribution: uniform row sampling with replacement from all 6340 isolated Learner rows

method_rules.random: select first proposal; zero selection-model forwards; identical across caps for a seed
method_rules.bon_cnn: argmax three-member CNN MRL mean among cap proposals; first proposal wins exact ties
method_rules.bon_kmer: argmax three-member 4-mer MLP MRL mean among identical cap proposals; first proposal wins exact ties
method_rules.lcb_cnn: argmax CNN MRL mean - 1.0 * sample std among identical cap proposals; lambda fixed a priori, not tuned

primary.estimand: mean sample-oracle TE regret over 100 paired algorithmic seeds and paired BoN-CNN minus Random regret
primary.regret: max TE over the frozen 6340 candidate rows minus selected-row TE; lower is better
primary.paired_effect_sign: BoN-CNN minus Random regret: negative favors BoN-CNN, positive favors Random; selected TE difference has opposite sign

score_matching.match_rule: nearest absolute architecture-specific MRL ensemble mean among different rows with different utr50; SHA256 of decimal row index then row index as deterministic tie break
score_matching.outcomes: selected TE minus matched TE and selected regret minus matched regret; no MRL-minus-TE absolute error because units differ
score_matching.sign: TE difference positive favors optimized; regret difference negative favors optimized
score_matching.bootstrap_conditioning: cluster bootstrap reruns selections and uses the frozen full-pool match map conditionally

bootstrap.procedure: resample biological clusters with replacement, rebuild the candidate pool, rerun all 100 paired proposal seeds and selections, recompute sample oracle and every method/cap effect; score matching is conditional on the frozen full-pool match map
bootstrap.boundary: candidate-pool biological-cluster uncertainty plus algorithmic draws; not independent-study replication
